name: personal-paper
description: PersonalPaper: an agent that finds the news stories significant to a defined set of interests and delivers a daily edition. Agent instructions, hosted environment, schema.

scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 execute personal-paper --local --file hosted/schema.sql && node hosted/seed/build-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute personal-paper --local --file hosted/seed/seed.sql
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 execute personal-paper --remote --file hosted/schema.sql && node hosted/seed/build-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute personal-paper --remote --file hosted/seed/seed.sql
